During the early days of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rajivari]] assembled a group of '''followers''', who participated in his [[Rajivari's purges|attempts]] to reshape the Order under [[Principles of Rajivari|Rajivari's set of principles]]. The followers were defeated by the Jedi Order during the [[Siege of Kaleth]], while their master abandoned them and retreated into the [[Fount of Rajivari]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Vadria Tallion]] and [[Human/Legends|Human]] males [[Orth Quane]] and [[Cahel Tse]] were members of Rajivari's faction.
